text1: Components recovered by disassembling hull items you no longer need.
Adds one more modifier to a hull item, up to four. A common hull item that gains its third modifier becomes rare.
Rerolls the values of every modifier on a hull item within its usual range.
Rewrites a unique hull item into a different unique hull item.
A dead station built around refineries and forges that worked the exotic matter of the abyss into ship components. Nothing has moved inside it in a very long time.
A station that gathered abyssal matter in bulk and processed it on site. Its collectors still face the nearest photosphere.
An abandoned research station that once studied the matter of the abyss. Most of its sensor booms have broken away.
An abyssal shipyard, its slips still holding drone hulls half assembled. Whatever built it left the defenders running.
A research complex sunk deep in the abyss, its laboratories still powered. Seraph-class drones keep watch over whatever was being studied here.
